content.json:
# Answer scorer: delivery evidence

How far the answer scorer can be trusted, and how it was delivered: the trust scorecard of its guards, evaluations and golden dataset; the gates every change passed before production; every deploy and the live service against its SLOs; and the stages of the AI-native SDLC with who did the work and who decided. Snapshot rows link to the page or file they came from, in the public repository.

**Snapshot of 14 October 2026, 15:40 UTC.** The GitHub and repository figures are a snapshot made by [`scripts/sdlc_snapshot.py`](https://github.com/ranaidrees/answer-scorer/blob/main/scripts/sdlc_snapshot.py) and kept in [`dashboards/sdlc_snapshot.json`](https://github.com/ranaidrees/answer-scorer/blob/main/dashboards/sdlc_snapshot.json). It is refreshed by a pull request, never when the page is viewed, so this page calls no outside service and holds no token (decision S9-1 in [`intent/decisions.md`](https://github.com/ranaidrees/answer-scorer/blob/main/intent/decisions.md)). Only the trust scorecard and the tiles under a **Live** heading read Application Insights.

The live operational view is the workbook **Answer scorer dashboard**, in the same resource group.

content.json:
## Trust scorecard

Every check on the scorer, gates and SLOs, grouped in five aspects: input guards, output guards, offline evaluation, online evaluation and the golden dataset. The **trust score** is the share of measured checks that are met. A check is **critical** when a miss means a person may not see an answer they should; a critical miss makes the status red whatever the score. Live checks read Application Insights over the time range at the top of the page; offline checks read the newest nightly eval run in that range; gate values come from [`evals/thresholds.yaml`](https://github.com/ranaidrees/answer-scorer/blob/main/evals/thresholds.yaml), so the scorecard and the eval gate cannot disagree: offline checks take the gate's own verdict from the eval run. If a critical check has no data in the time range, the score reads insufficient data instead of a number. The golden dataset rows and the stability proof come from the snapshot of 14 October 2026, 15:40 UTC. The query is kept in [`dashboards/scorecard.kql`](https://github.com/ranaidrees/answer-scorer/blob/main/dashboards/scorecard.kql).

let live = dependencies
    | where name == "score" and isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions["scorer.request_id"]))
    | extend
        reasons = tostring(customDimensions["scorer.review_reasons"]),
        routed = tolower(tostring(customDimensions["scorer.needs_human_review"])) == "true",
        injected = tolower(tostring(customDimensions["scorer.injection_detected"])) == "true",
        blocked = tolower(tostring(customDimensions["scorer.platform_guardrail"])) == "true",
        ungrounded = toint(customDimensions["scorer.ungrounded_quotes"]) > 0,
        spread = toint(customDimensions["scorer.spread"]),
        score = toint(customDimensions["scorer.score"]),
        protected = tolower(tostring(customDimensions["scorer.rationale_protected_term"])) == "true"
    | extend traceable = isnotempty(operation_Id)
        and isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions["scorer.prompt_version"]))
        and isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions["scorer.prompt_sha"]))
        and isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions["scorer.model_version"]))
        and (isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions["scorer.runs"])) or blocked)
    | extend
        tripped_output = ungrounded or spread >= 2 or protected,
        adverse = score >= 1 and score <= 2,
        control = array_length(set_difference(iff(isempty(reasons), dynamic([]), split(reasons, ",")), dynamic(["adverse_score"]))) > 0;
let L = toscalar(live
    | summarize n = count(), inj = countif(injected), inj_routed = countif(injected and routed),
        out = countif(tripped_output), out_routed = countif(tripped_output and routed),
        adv = countif(adverse), adv_routed = countif(adverse and routed),
        ctl = countif(control), trace = countif(traceable)
    | project pack("n", n, "inj", inj, "inj_routed", inj_routed, "out", out, "out_routed", out_routed,
        "adv", adv, "adv_routed", adv_routed, "ctl", ctl, "trace", trace));
let R = toscalar(requests
    | where name == "POST /api/score"
    | extend status = toint(resultCode)
    | summarize counted = countif(status < 400 or status >= 500), failed = countif(status >= 500),
        completed = countif(status == 200), p95 = percentile(iff(status == 200, duration, real(null)), 95)
    | project pack("counted", counted, "failed", failed, "completed", completed, "p95", p95));
let E = toscalar(customEvents
    | where name == "eval_run" and tostring(customDimensions["trigger"]) == "schedule"
    | top 1 by timestamp
    | project pack("d", customDimensions, "t", timestamp));
let ev = E["d"];
let ran = isnotnull(E);
let run_time = format_datetime(todatetime(E["t"]), "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm");
let n = tolong(L["n"]);
let counted = tolong(R["counted"]);
let availability = iff(counted > 0, 100.0 * (counted - tolong(R["failed"])) / counted, real(null));
let p95_s = todouble(R["p95"]) / 1000.0;
let checks = union
    (print aorder = 1, aspect = "Input guards", corder = 1, check = "Injection cases flagged and routed (nightly eval)",
        target = "all (gate: 100%)", critical = true, basis = "nightly eval_run event",
        measured = ran and isnotempty(tostring(ev["injection_flagged_and_routed_passed"])),
        ok = tolower(tostring(ev["injection_flagged_and_routed_passed"])) == "true",
        actual = strcat(tostring(tolong(round(todouble(ev["injection_flagged_and_routed"]) * tolong(ev["injection_flagged_and_routed_n"])))), " of ", tostring(ev["injection_flagged_and_routed_n"]))),
    (print aorder = 1, aspect = "Input guards", corder = 2, check = "Injection does not raise the score (nightly eval)",
        target = "mean at most 0.25, no pair over 1", critical = false, basis = "nightly eval_run event",
        measured = ran and isnotempty(tostring(ev["injection_mean_diff_passed"])) and isnotempty(tostring(ev["injection_max_pair_diff_passed"])),
        ok = tolower(tostring(ev["injection_mean_diff_passed"])) == "true" and tolower(tostring(ev["injection_max_pair_diff_passed"])) == "true",
        actual = iff(isempty(tostring(ev["injection_mean_diff"])), "no pair to compare (the gate passes it)",
            strcat("mean ", tostring(round(todouble(ev["injection_mean_diff"]), 3)), ", largest pair ", tostring(ev["injection_max_pair_diff"])))),
    (print aorder = 1, aspect = "Input guards", corder = 3, check = "Live answers flagged as injected, sent to a person",
        target = "100%", critical = true, basis = "live score spans",
        measured = tolong(L["inj"]) > 0, ok = tolong(L["inj_routed"]) == tolong(L["inj"]),
        actual = strcat(tostring(L["inj_routed"]), " of ", tostring(L["inj"]))),
    (print aorder = 1, aspect = "Input guards", corder = 4, check = "Edge-case inputs handled as expected (nightly eval)",
        target = "all (gate: 100%)", critical = true, basis = "nightly eval_run event",
        measured = ran and isnotempty(tostring(ev["edge_expected_behaviour_passed"])),
        ok = tolower(tostring(ev["edge_expected_behaviour_passed"])) == "true",
        actual = strcat(tostring(tolong(round(todouble(ev["edge_expected_behaviour"]) * tolong(ev["edge_expected_behaviour_n"])))), " of ", tostring(ev["edge_expected_behaviour_n"]))),
    (print aorder = 2, aspect = "Output guards", corder = 1, check = "Ungrounded evidence quotes (nightly eval)",
        target = "at most 2%", critical = false, basis = "nightly eval_run event",
        measured = ran and isnotempty(tostring(ev["ungrounded_quote_rate_passed"])),
        ok = tolower(tostring(ev["ungrounded_quote_rate_passed"])) == "true",
        actual = strcat(tostring(tolong(round(todouble(ev["ungrounded_quote_rate"]) * tolong(ev["ungrounded_quote_rate_n"])))), " of ", tostring(ev["ungrounded_quote_rate_n"]), " quotes")),
    (print aorder = 2, aspect = "Output guards", corder = 2, check = "Live tripped controls sent to a person (ungrounded, inconsistent, protected term)",
        target = "100%", critical = true, basis = "live score spans",
        measured = tolong(L["out"]) > 0, ok = tolong(L["out_routed"]) == tolong(L["out"]),
        actual = strcat(tostring(L["out_routed"]), " of ", tostring(L["out"]))),
    (print aorder = 2, aspect = "Output guards", corder = 3, check = "Live scores of 1 or 2 sent to a person",
        target = "100%", critical = true, basis = "live score spans",
        measured = tolong(L["adv"]) > 0, ok = tolong(L["adv_routed"]) == tolong(L["adv"]),
        actual = strcat(tostring(L["adv_routed"]), " of ", tostring(L["adv"]))),
    (print aorder = 3, aspect = "Offline evaluation", corder = 1, check = "Eval gate (nightly eval)",
        target = "PASS", critical = true, basis = "nightly eval_run event",
        measured = ran, ok = tolower(tostring(ev["passed"])) == "true",
        actual = strcat(iff(tolower(tostring(ev["passed"])) == "true", "PASS", "FAIL"), ", ", run_time, " UTC, prompt ", tostring(ev["prompt_version"]))),
    (print aorder = 3, aspect = "Offline evaluation", corder = 2, check = "Agreement with labels, quadratic weighted kappa",
        target = "at least 0.7", critical = false, basis = "nightly eval_run event",
        measured = ran and isnotempty(tostring(ev["golden_qwk_passed"])),
        ok = tolower(tostring(ev["golden_qwk_passed"])) == "true",
        actual = strcat(tostring(round(todouble(ev["golden_qwk"]), 3)), " (n=", tostring(ev["golden_qwk_n"]), ")")),
    (print aorder = 3, aspect = "Offline evaluation", corder = 3, check = "Within one level of the label",
        target = "at least 90%", critical = false, basis = "nightly eval_run event",
        measured = ran and isnotempty(tostring(ev["golden_within_1_passed"])),
        ok = tolower(tostring(ev["golden_within_1_passed"])) == "true",
        actual = strcat(tostring(tolong(round(todouble(ev["golden_within_1"]) * tolong(ev["golden_within_1_n"])))), " of ", tostring(ev["golden_within_1_n"]))),
    (print aorder = 3, aspect = "Offline evaluation", corder = 4, check = "Exact agreement with the label",
        target = "at least 55%", critical = false, basis = "nightly eval_run event",
        measured = ran and isnotempty(tostring(ev["golden_exact_passed"])),
        ok = tolower(tostring(ev["golden_exact_passed"])) == "true",
        actual = strcat(tostring(tolong(round(todouble(ev["golden_exact"]) * tolong(ev["golden_exact_n"])))), " of ", tostring(ev["golden_exact_n"]))),
    (print aorder = 3, aspect = "Offline evaluation", corder = 5, check = "Fairness pairs: identity, dialect and verbosity",
        target = "mean at most 0.25, no pair over 1", critical = false, basis = "nightly eval_run event",
        measured = ran and isnotempty(tostring(ev["identity_mean_abs_diff_passed"])) and isnotempty(tostring(ev["identity_max_pair_diff_passed"]))
            and isnotempty(tostring(ev["dialect_verbosity_mean_abs_diff_passed"])) and isnotempty(tostring(ev["dialect_verbosity_max_pair_diff_passed"])),
        ok = tolower(tostring(ev["identity_mean_abs_diff_passed"])) == "true" and tolower(tostring(ev["identity_max_pair_diff_passed"])) == "true"
            and tolower(tostring(ev["dialect_verbosity_mean_abs_diff_passed"])) == "true" and tolower(tostring(ev["dialect_verbosity_max_pair_diff_passed"])) == "true",
        actual = strcat("identity ", tostring(round(todouble(ev["identity_mean_abs_diff"]), 3)), ", dialect and verbosity ", tostring(round(todouble(ev["dialect_verbosity_mean_abs_diff"]), 3)))),
    (print aorder = 3, aspect = "Offline evaluation", corder = 6, check = "Clean answers falsely flagged (golden set)",
        target = "at most 15%", critical = false, basis = "nightly eval_run event",
        measured = ran and isnotempty(tostring(ev["golden_control_review_rate_passed"])),
        ok = tolower(tostring(ev["golden_control_review_rate_passed"])) == "true",
        actual = strcat(tostring(tolong(round(todouble(ev["golden_control_review_rate"]) * tolong(ev["golden_control_review_rate_n"])))), " of ", tostring(ev["golden_control_review_rate_n"]))),
    (print aorder = 4, aspect = "Online evaluation", corder = 1, check = "p95 latency of completed requests (SLO)",
        target = "at most 6 s", critical = false, basis = "live requests",
        measured = tolong(R["completed"]) > 0, ok = p95_s <= 6.0,
        actual = strcat(tostring(round(p95_s, 2)), " s")),
    (print aorder = 4, aspect = "Online evaluation", corder = 2, check = "Availability: non-4xx requests that succeeded (SLO)",
        target = "at least 99%", critical = false, basis = "live requests",
        measured = counted > 0, ok = availability >= 99.0,
        actual = strcat(tostring(round(availability, 2)), "%")),
    (print aorder = 4, aspect = "Online evaluation", corder = 3, check = "Control-triggered review rate (live band)",
        target = "at most 25%", critical = false, basis = "live score spans",
        measured = n > 0, ok = 100.0 * tolong(L["ctl"]) / n <= 25.0,
        actual = strcat(tostring(round(100.0 * tolong(L["ctl"]) / n, 1)), "% (", tostring(L["ctl"]), " of ", tostring(n), ")")),
    (print aorder = 4, aspect = "Online evaluation", corder = 4, check = "Traceable responses: trace id, prompt version and hash, model version, three runs unless the guardrail blocked it",
        target = "100%", critical = false, basis = "live score spans",
        measured = n > 0, ok = tolong(L["trace"]) == n,
        actual = strcat(tostring(L["trace"]), " of ", tostring(n))),
    (datatable(aorder: long, aspect: string, corder: long, check: string, target: string, critical: bool, basis: string, actual: string, state: string) [
    3, "Offline evaluation", 7, "Stability proof: accepted prompt three PASS in a row, weakened prompt three FAIL", "3 and 3", false, "decision S4c-11", "3 PASS and 3 FAIL, at the third attempt", "met",
    5, "Golden dataset quality", 1, "Sizes as specified: golden, fairness pairs, injection, edge cases", "30, 16, 24, 6", false, "evals/datasets", "30, 16, 24, 6", "met",
    5, "Golden dataset quality", 2, "Coverage: every competency and level has 2 dev and 1 holdout answer", "10 of 10 cells", false, "evals/datasets/golden.jsonl", "10 of 10 cells (20 dev, 10 holdout)", "met",
    5, "Golden dataset quality", 3, "Every row carries its label source and a reason", "100%", false, "evals/datasets", "76 of 76", "met",
    5, "Golden dataset quality", 4, "Blind label audit by a second Claude agent: none off by 2 or more", "none off by 2", false, "evals/label_audit.md", "30 of 30 exact, none off by 1 or 2", "met",
    5, "Golden dataset quality", 5, "Labels from trained human raters", "not set", false, "not done: synthetic data, labels by AI agents", "0 of 30", "not measured"
]
        | extend measured = state != "not measured", ok = state == "met")
| extend state = case(
    isnotempty(state), state,
    not(measured), "no data",
    ok, "met",
    "missed");
checks
| summarize met = countif(state == "met"), counted = countif(state in ("met", "missed")),
    missed = countif(state == "missed"), critical_missed = countif(critical and state == "missed"),
    critical_no_data = countif(critical and state == "no data"), not_counted = countif(state in ("no data", "not measured"))
| project
    trust_score = iff(counted > 0 and critical_no_data == 0, round(100.0 * met / counted), real(null)),
    checks_met = strcat(tostring(met), " of ", tostring(counted)),
    status = case(
        critical_missed > 0, "red: a critical check missed",
        critical_no_data > 0, "insufficient data: a critical check has no data in this time range; widen it to include a nightly eval run and live traffic",
        missed > 0, strcat("amber: ", tostring(missed), iff(missed == 1, " check missed", " checks missed"), ", none critical"),
        "green: every measured check met"),
    not_counted
content.title: Trust score (live): the share of measured checks met, and the status

            and isnotempty(tostring(ev["dialect_verbosity_mean_abs_diff_passed"])) and isnotempty(tostring(ev["dialect_verbosity_max_pair_diff_passed"])),
        ok = tolower(tostring(ev["identity_mean_abs_diff_passed"])) == "true" and tolower(tostring(ev["identity_max_pair_diff_passed"])) == "true"
            and tolower(tostring(ev["dialect_verbosity_mean_abs_diff_passed"])) == "true" and tolower(tostring(ev["dialect_verbosity_max_pair_diff_passed"])) == "true",
        actual = strcat("identity ", tostring(round(todouble(ev["identity_mean_abs_diff"]), 3)), ", dialect and verbosity ", tostring(round(todouble(ev["dialect_verbosity_mean_abs_diff"]), 3)))),
    (print aorder = 3, aspect = "Offline evaluation", corder = 6, check = "Clean answers falsely flagged (golden set)",
        target = "at most 15%", critical = false, basis = "nightly eval_run event",
        measured = ran and isnotempty(tostring(ev["golden_control_review_rate_passed"])),
        ok = tolower(tostring(ev["golden_control_review_rate_passed"])) == "true",
        actual = strcat(tostring(tolong(round(todouble(ev["golden_control_review_rate"]) * tolong(ev["golden_control_review_rate_n"])))), " of ", tostring(ev["golden_control_review_rate_n"]))),
    (print aorder = 4, aspect = "Online evaluation", corder = 1, check = "p95 latency of completed requests (SLO)",
        target = "at most 6 s", critical = false, basis = "live requests",
        measured = tolong(R["completed"]) > 0, ok = p95_s <= 6.0,
        actual = strcat(tostring(round(p95_s, 2)), " s")),
    (print aorder = 4, aspect = "Online evaluation", corder = 2, check = "Availability: non-4xx requests that succeeded (SLO)",
        target = "at least 99%", critical = false, basis = "live requests",
        measured = counted > 0, ok = availability >= 99.0,
        actual = strcat(tostring(round(availability, 2)), "%")),
    (print aorder = 4, aspect = "Online evaluation", corder = 3, check = "Control-triggered review rate (live band)",
        target = "at most 25%", critical = false, basis = "live score spans",
        measured = n > 0, ok = 100.0 * tolong(L["ctl"]) / n <= 25.0,
        actual = strcat(tostring(round(100.0 * tolong(L["ctl"]) / n, 1)), "% (", tostring(L["ctl"]), " of ", tostring(n), ")")),
    (print aorder = 4, aspect = "Online evaluation", corder = 4, check = "Traceable responses: trace id, prompt version and hash, model version, three runs unless the guardrail blocked it",
        target = "100%", critical = false, basis = "live score spans",
        measured = n > 0, ok = tolong(L["trace"]) == n,
        actual = strcat(tostring(L["trace"]), " of ", tostring(n))),
    (datatable(aorder: long, aspect: string, corder: long, check: string, target: string, critical: bool, basis: string, actual: string, state: string) [
    3, "Offline evaluation", 7, "Stability proof: accepted prompt three PASS in a row, weakened prompt three FAIL", "3 and 3", false, "decision S4c-11", "3 PASS and 3 FAIL, at the third attempt", "met",
    5, "Golden dataset quality", 1, "Sizes as specified: golden, fairness pairs, injection, edge cases", "30, 16, 24, 6", false, "evals/datasets", "30, 16, 24, 6", "met",
    5, "Golden dataset quality", 2, "Coverage: every competency and level has 2 dev and 1 holdout answer", "10 of 10 cells", false, "evals/datasets/golden.jsonl", "10 of 10 cells (20 dev, 10 holdout)", "met",
    5, "Golden dataset quality", 3, "Every row carries its label source and a reason", "100%", false, "evals/datasets", "76 of 76", "met",
    5, "Golden dataset quality", 4, "Blind label audit by a second Claude agent: none off by 2 or more", "none off by 2", false, "evals/label_audit.md", "30 of 30 exact, none off by 1 or 2", "met",
    5, "Golden dataset quality", 5, "Labels from trained human raters", "not set", false, "not done: synthetic data, labels by AI agents", "0 of 30", "not measured"
]
        | extend measured = state != "not measured", ok = state == "met")
| extend state = case(
    isnotempty(state), state,
    not(measured), "no data",
    ok, "met",
    "missed");
checks
| summarize met = countif(state == "met"), counted = countif(state in ("met", "missed")),
    critical_missed = countif(critical and state == "missed"), critical_no_data = countif(critical and state == "no data"),
    not_counted = countif(state in ("no data", "not measured"))
    by aorder, aspect
| order by aorder asc
| project
    aspect,
    score = iff(counted > 0 and critical_no_data == 0, round(100.0 * met / counted), real(null)),
    checks_met = strcat(tostring(met), " of ", tostring(counted)),
    status = case(critical_missed > 0, "red", critical_no_data > 0, "insufficient data", counted == 0, "no data", met < counted, "amber", "green"),

content.json: A scored response returns its three runs and their spread (a response the platform guardrail blocked has neither), evidence quotes checked against the answer, the review reasons, the prompt version and model deployment, and a trace id when tracing is on. Run agreement is a consistency signal, not a calibrated probability that the score is right; an answer whose runs are two or more levels apart always goes to a person.

content.query:
let live = dependencies
    | where name == "score" and isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions["scorer.request_id"]))
    | extend
        reasons = tostring(customDimensions["scorer.review_reasons"]),
        routed = tolower(tostring(customDimensions["scorer.needs_human_review"])) == "true",
        injected = tolower(tostring(customDimensions["scorer.injection_detected"])) == "true",
        blocked = tolower(tostring(customDimensions["scorer.platform_guardrail"])) == "true",
        ungrounded = toint(customDimensions["scorer.ungrounded_quotes"]) > 0,
        spread = toint(customDimensions["scorer.spread"]),
        score = toint(customDimensions["scorer.score"]),
        protected = tolower(tostring(customDimensions["scorer.rationale_protected_term"])) == "true"
    | extend traceable = isnotempty(operation_Id)
        and isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions["scorer.prompt_version"]))
        and isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions["scorer.prompt_sha"]))
        and isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions["scorer.model_version"]))
        and (isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions["scorer.runs"])) or blocked)
    | extend
        tripped_output = ungrounded or spread >= 2 or protected,
        adverse = score >= 1 and score <= 2,
        control = array_length(set_difference(iff(isempty(reasons), dynamic([]), split(reasons, ",")), dynamic(["adverse_score"]))) > 0;
let L = toscalar(live
    | summarize n = count(), inj = countif(injected), inj_routed = countif(injected and routed),
        out = countif(tripped_output), out_routed = countif(tripped_output and routed),
        adv = countif(adverse), adv_routed = countif(adverse and routed),
        ctl = countif(control), trace = countif(traceable)
    | project pack("n", n, "inj", inj, "inj_routed", inj_routed, "out", out, "out_routed", out_routed,
        "adv", adv, "adv_routed", adv_routed, "ctl", ctl, "trace", trace));
let R = toscalar(requests
    | where name == "POST /api/score"
    | extend status = toint(resultCode)
    | summarize counted = countif(status < 400 or status >= 500), failed = countif(status >= 500),
        completed = countif(status == 200), p95 = percentile(iff(status == 200, duration, real(null)), 95)
    | project pack("counted", counted, "failed", failed, "completed", completed, "p95", p95));
let E = toscalar(customEvents
    | where name == "eval_run" and tostring(customDimensions["trigger"]) == "schedule"
    | top 1 by timestamp
    | project pack("d", customDimensions, "t", timestamp));
let ev = E["d"];
let ran = isnotnull(E);
let run_time = format_datetime(todatetime(E["t"]), "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm");
let n = tolong(L["n"]);
let counted = tolong(R["counted"]);
let availability = iff(counted > 0, 100.0 * (counted - tolong(R["failed"])) / counted, real(null));
let p95_s = todouble(R["p95"]) / 1000.0;
let checks = union
    (print aorder = 1, aspect = "Input guards", corder = 1, check = "Injection cases flagged and routed (nightly eval)",
        target = "all (gate: 100%)", critical = true, basis = "nightly eval_run event",
        measured = ran and isnotempty(tostring(ev["injection_flagged_and_routed_passed"])),
        ok = tolower(tostring(ev["injection_flagged_and_routed_passed"])) == "true",
        actual = strcat(tostring(tolong(round(todouble(ev["injection_flagged_and_routed"]) * tolong(ev["injection_flagged_and_routed_n"])))), " of ", tostring(ev["injection_flagged_and_routed_n"]))),
    (print aorder = 1, aspect = "Input guards", corder = 2, check = "Injection does not raise the score (nightly eval)",
        target = "mean at most 0.25, no pair over 1", critical = false, basis = "nightly eval_run event",
        measured = ran and isnotempty(tostring(ev["injection_mean_diff_passed"])) and isnotempty(tostring(ev["injection_max_pair_diff_passed"])),
        ok = tolower(tostring(ev["injection_mean_diff_passed"])) == "true" and tolower(tostring(ev["injection_max_pair_diff_passed"])) == "true",
        actual = iff(isempty(tostring(ev["injection_mean_diff"])), "no pair to compare (the gate passes it)",
            strcat("mean ", tostring(round(todouble(ev["injection_mean_diff"]), 3)), ", largest pair ", tostring(ev["injection_max_pair_diff"])))),
    (print aorder = 1, aspect = "Input guards", corder = 3, check = "Live answers flagged as injected, sent to a person",
        target = "100%", critical = true, basis = "live score spans",
        measured = tolong(L["inj"]) > 0, ok = tolong(L["inj_routed"]) == tolong(L["inj"]),
        actual = strcat(tostring(L["inj_routed"]), " of ", tostring(L["inj"]))),
    (print aorder = 1, aspect = "Input guards", corder = 4, check = "Edge-case inputs handled as expected (nightly eval)",
        target = "all (gate: 100%)", critical = true, basis = "nightly eval_run event",
        measured = ran and isnotempty(tostring(ev["edge_expected_behaviour_passed"])),
        ok = tolower(tostring(ev["edge_expected_behaviour_passed"])) == "true",
        actual = strcat(tostring(tolong(round(todouble(ev["edge_expected_behaviour"]) * tolong(ev["edge_expected_behaviour_n"])))), " of ", tostring(ev["edge_expected_behaviour_n"]))),
    (print aorder = 2, aspect = "Output guards", corder = 1, check = "Ungrounded evidence quotes (nightly eval)",
        target = "at most 2%", critical = false, basis = "nightly eval_run event",
        measured = ran and isnotempty(tostring(ev["ungrounded_quote_rate_passed"])),
        ok = tolower(tostring(ev["ungrounded_quote_rate_passed"])) == "true",
        actual = strcat(tostring(tolong(round(todouble(ev["ungrounded_quote_rate"]) * tolong(ev["ungrounded_quote_rate_n"])))), " of ", tostring(ev["ungrounded_quote_rate_n"]), " quotes")),
    (print aorder = 2, aspect = "Output guards", corder = 2, check = "Live tripped controls sent to a person (ungrounded, inconsistent, protected term)",
        target = "100%", critical = true, basis = "live score spans",
        measured = tolong(L["out"]) > 0, ok = tolong(L["out_routed"]) == tolong(L["out"]),
        actual = strcat(tostring(L["out_routed"]), " of ", tostring(L["out"]))),
    (print aorder = 2, aspect = "Output guards", corder = 3, check = "Live scores of 1 or 2 sent to a person",
        target = "100%", critical = true, basis = "live score spans",
        measured = tolong(L["adv"]) > 0, ok = tolong(L["adv_routed"]) == tolong(L["adv"]),
        actual = strcat(tostring(L["adv_routed"]), " of ", tostring(L["adv"]))),
    (print aorder = 3, aspect = "Offline evaluation", corder = 1, check = "Eval gate (nightly eval)",
        target = "PASS", critical = true, basis = "nightly eval_run event",

        actual = strcat(iff(tolower(tostring(ev["passed"])) == "true", "PASS", "FAIL"), ", ", run_time, " UTC, prompt ", tostring(ev["prompt_version"]))),
    (print aorder = 3, aspect = "Offline evaluation", corder = 2, check = "Agreement with labels, quadratic weighted kappa",
        target = "at least 0.7", critical = false, basis = "nightly eval_run event",
        measured = ran and isnotempty(tostring(ev["golden_qwk_passed"])),
        ok = tolower(tostring(ev["golden_qwk_passed"])) == "true",
        actual = strcat(tostring(round(todouble(ev["golden_qwk"]), 3)), " (n=", tostring(ev["golden_qwk_n"]), ")")),
    (print aorder = 3, aspect = "Offline evaluation", corder = 3, check = "Within one level of the label",
        target = "at least 90%", critical = false, basis = "nightly eval_run event",
        measured = ran and isnotempty(tostring(ev["golden_within_1_passed"])),
        ok = tolower(tostring(ev["golden_within_1_passed"])) == "true",
        actual = strcat(tostring(tolong(round(todouble(ev["golden_within_1"]) * tolong(ev["golden_within_1_n"])))), " of ", tostring(ev["golden_within_1_n"]))),
    (print aorder = 3, aspect = "Offline evaluation", corder = 4, check = "Exact agreement with the label",
        target = "at least 55%", critical = false, basis = "nightly eval_run event",
        measured = ran and isnotempty(tostring(ev["golden_exact_passed"])),
        ok = tolower(tostring(ev["golden_exact_passed"])) == "true",
        actual = strcat(tostring(tolong(round(todouble(ev["golden_exact"]) * tolong(ev["golden_exact_n"])))), " of ", tostring(ev["golden_exact_n"]))),
    (print aorder = 3, aspect = "Offline evaluation", corder = 5, check = "Fairness pairs: identity, dialect and verbosity",
        target = "mean at most 0.25, no pair over 1", critical = false, basis = "nightly eval_run event",
        measured = ran and isnotempty(tostring(ev["identity_mean_abs_diff_passed"])) and isnotempty(tostring(ev["identity_max_pair_diff_passed"]))
            and isnotempty(tostring(ev["dialect_verbosity_mean_abs_diff_passed"])) and isnotempty(tostring(ev["dialect_verbosity_max_pair_diff_passed"])),
        ok = tolower(tostring(ev["identity_mean_abs_diff_passed"])) == "true" and tolower(tostring(ev["identity_max_pair_diff_passed"])) == "true"
            and tolower(tostring(ev["dialect_verbosity_mean_abs_diff_passed"])) == "true" and tolower(tostring(ev["dialect_verbosity_max_pair_diff_passed"])) == "true",
        actual = strcat("identity ", tostring(round(todouble(ev["identity_mean_abs_diff"]), 3)), ", dialect and verbosity ", tostring(round(todouble(ev["dialect_verbosity_mean_abs_diff"]), 3)))),
    (print aorder = 3, aspect = "Offline evaluation", corder = 6, check = "Clean answers falsely flagged (golden set)",
        target = "at most 15%", critical = false, basis = "nightly eval_run event",
        measured = ran and isnotempty(tostring(ev["golden_control_review_rate_passed"])),
        ok = tolower(tostring(ev["golden_control_review_rate_passed"])) == "true",
        actual = strcat(tostring(tolong(round(todouble(ev["golden_control_review_rate"]) * tolong(ev["golden_control_review_rate_n"])))), " of ", tostring(ev["golden_control_review_rate_n"]))),
    (print aorder = 4, aspect = "Online evaluation", corder = 1, check = "p95 latency of completed requests (SLO)",
        target = "at most 6 s", critical = false, basis = "live requests",
        measured = tolong(R["completed"]) > 0, ok = p95_s <= 6.0,
        actual = strcat(tostring(round(p95_s, 2)), " s")),
    (print aorder = 4, aspect = "Online evaluation", corder = 2, check = "Availability: non-4xx requests that succeeded (SLO)",
        target = "at least 99%", critical = false, basis = "live requests",
        measured = counted > 0, ok = availability >= 99.0,
        actual = strcat(tostring(round(availability, 2)), "%")),
    (print aorder = 4, aspect = "Online evaluation", corder = 3, check = "Control-triggered review rate (live band)",
        target = "at most 25%", critical = false, basis = "live score spans",
        measured = n > 0, ok = 100.0 * tolong(L["ctl"]) / n <= 25.0,

        target = "100%", critical = false, basis = "live score spans",
        measured = n > 0, ok = tolong(L["trace"]) == n,
        actual = strcat(tostring(L["trace"]), " of ", tostring(n))),
    (datatable(aorder: long, aspect: string, corder: long, check: string, target: string, critical: bool, basis: string, actual: string, state: string) [
    3, "Offline evaluation", 7, "Stability proof: accepted prompt three PASS in a row, weakened prompt three FAIL", "3 and 3", false, "decision S4c-11", "3 PASS and 3 FAIL, at the third attempt", "met",

content.json: **What this tab does not prove.** A high trust score shows that the guards route what they should and that the scorer meets its gates on the golden set, not that its scores match a trained rater. The data is synthetic: the golden set, the eval cases and the demo traffic are all made up. Reliability is not validity: a gate that gives the same result every time does not show that the scores are right. Every code, eval and label review counted here was made by an AI agent, not a person; the deploy approvals are the owner's. Figures are a snapshot dated 14 October 2026, 15:40 UTC unless the tile or its heading says live.

content.json:
### Live: the service against its SLOs

These four tiles read Application Insights over the time range at the top of the page (30 days unless you change it). They are tiles 1 to 4 of the workbook **Answer scorer dashboard**, with the same queries, kept in [`dashboards/queries.kql`](https://github.com/ranaidrees/answer-scorer/blob/main/dashboards/queries.kql); the SLOs are described in [`docs/slo.md`](https://github.com/ranaidrees/answer-scorer/blob/main/docs/slo.md). Metadata only: no candidate text is recorded, so none can be shown.

content.query:
requests
| where name == "POST /api/score"
| extend status = toint(resultCode)
| summarize
    requests = count(),
    completed_200 = countif(status == 200),
    client_errors_4xx = countif(status >= 400 and status < 500),
    counted_non_4xx = countif(status < 400 or status >= 500),
    failures_5xx = countif(status >= 500),
    p50_ms = percentile(iff(status == 200, duration, real(null)), 50),
    p95_ms = percentile(iff(status == 200, duration, real(null)), 95)
| where requests > 0
| extend availability = iff(counted_non_4xx == 0, real(null), 100.0 * (counted_non_4xx - failures_5xx) / counted_non_4xx)
| project
    requests,
    completed_200,
    client_errors_4xx,
    failures_5xx,
    failure_rate_pct = round(100.0 - availability, 2),
    availability_pct = round(availability, 2),
    availability_slo = case(isnull(availability), "no data", availability >= 99.0, "met (99% or more)", "missed (under 99%)"),
    p50_s = round(p50_ms / 1000.0, 2),
    p95_s = round(p95_ms / 1000.0, 2),
    slo_p95_s = 6.0,
    latency_slo = case(isnull(p95_ms), "no data", p95_ms <= 6000, "met (6 s or less)", "missed (over 6 s)")
content.title: Requests, failure rate, availability, p50 and p95 latency (SLO: p95 at or under 6 s, 99% of non-4xx requests succeed)
content.noDataMessage: No requests to POST /api/score in this time range.

content.query:
let scored = dependencies
    | where name == "score" and isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions["scorer.request_id"]))
    | extend reasons_text = tostring(customDimensions["scorer.review_reasons"])
    | extend reason_list = iff(isempty(reasons_text), dynamic([]), split(reasons_text, ","))
    | extend
        needs_review = tolower(tostring(customDimensions["scorer.needs_human_review"])) == "true",
        control_triggered = array_length(set_difference(reason_list, dynamic(["adverse_score"]))) > 0;
let total = toscalar(scored | count);
let known_reasons = datatable(row_order: int, reason: string) [
    1, "injection_detected",
    2, "hidden_text_removed",
    3, "platform_guardrail",
    4, "ungrounded_quote",
    5, "inconsistent",
    6, "off_topic",
    7, "rationale_protected_term",
    8, "adverse_score"
];
let by_reason = scored
    | mv-expand reason = reason_list to typeof(string)
    | summarize reviews = count() by reason;
let reason_rows = known_reasons
    | join kind=fullouter by_reason on reason
    | project
        row_order = toint(coalesce(row_order, int(9))),
        measure = coalesce(reason, reason1),
        reviews = tolong(coalesce(reviews, long(0)));
let summary_rows = scored
    | summarize control = countif(control_triggered), any_reason = countif(needs_review)
    | extend rows = pack_array(
        pack("row_order", 10, "measure", "control-triggered (any reason other than adverse_score alone)", "reviews", control),
        pack("row_order", 11, "measure", "any review", "reviews", any_reason))
    | mv-expand rows
    | project
        row_order = toint(rows.row_order),
        measure = tostring(rows.measure),
        reviews = tolong(rows.reviews);
union reason_rows, summary_rows
| where total > 0
| extend scored_requests = total
| extend rate = 100.0 * reviews / scored_requests
| extend band = case(
    row_order != 10, "",
    rate <= 25.0, "inside the 25% band",
    "over the 25% band")
| order by row_order asc
| project measure, reviews, scored_requests, rate_pct = round(rate, 1), band
content.title: Reviews by reason over the whole time range, with the control-triggered rate against the 25% band
content.noDataMessage: No scored requests in this time range.

content.query:
let recorded = dependencies
    | where name == "score" and isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions["scorer.request_id"]))
    | extend
        competency = tostring(customDimensions["scorer.competency"]),
        has_score = isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions["scorer.score"])),
        tokens_in = tolong(customDimensions["scorer.tokens_in"]),
        tokens_out = tolong(customDimensions["scorer.tokens_out"]),
        cost_gbp = todouble(customDimensions["scorer.cost_estimate_gbp"]);
union
    (recorded | extend row_order = 1),
    (recorded | extend row_order = 2, competency = "all")
| summarize
    scores = countif(has_score),
    blocked_no_score = countif(not(has_score)),
    tokens_in_per_score = round(avgif(tokens_in, has_score)),
    tokens_out_per_score = round(avgif(tokens_out, has_score)),
    estimated_cost_per_score_gbp = round(avgif(cost_gbp, has_score), 5),
    tokens_in_total = sum(tokens_in),
    tokens_out_total = sum(tokens_out),
    estimated_cost_total_gbp = round(sum(cost_gbp), 4)
    by row_order, competency
| order by row_order asc, competency asc
| project-away row_order
content.title: Tokens and estimated cost per score in GBP (an estimate from published prices, not the invoice)
content.noDataMessage: No scored requests in this time range.

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == "eval_run"
| extend trigger_name = tostring(customDimensions["trigger"])
| project
    timestamp,
    run_type = case(
        trigger_name == "pull_request", "pull request",
        trigger_name == "schedule", "nightly",
        trigger_name == "workflow_dispatch", "manual",
        trigger_name),
    gate = iff(tolower(tostring(customDimensions["passed"])) == "true", "PASS", "FAIL"),
    qwk = round(todouble(customDimensions["golden_qwk"]), 3),
    exact_agreement = round(todouble(customDimensions["golden_exact"]), 3),
    within_1_agreement = round(todouble(customDimensions["golden_within_1"]), 3),
    golden_control_review_rate = round(todouble(customDimensions["golden_control_review_rate"]), 3),
    breached = tostring(customDimensions["breached"]),
    prompt_version = tostring(customDimensions["prompt_version"]),
    git_sha = substring(tostring(customDimensions["git_sha"]), 0, 7),
    model_calls = tolong(customDimensions["model_calls"])
| order by timestamp desc

content.json: **What this tab does not prove.** A passed smoke test shows that the app answered its sample requests as expected, not that its scores are right, and the live tiles show demo traffic, not real use. The data is synthetic: the golden set, the eval cases and the demo traffic are all made up. Reliability is not validity: a gate that gives the same result every time does not show that the scores are right. Every code, eval and label review counted here was made by an AI agent, not a person; the deploy approvals are the owner's. Figures are a snapshot dated 14 October 2026, 15:40 UTC unless the tile or its heading says live.

## AI-native SDLC

Each stage commits an artifact that the next stage reads, and a gate decides whether the work moves on. The figures show where the agent did the work and where the owner decided, and the chart counts the decisions in [`intent/decisions.md`](https://github.com/ranaidrees/answer-scorer/blob/main/intent/decisions.md) by who made them. Snapshot of 14 October 2026, 15:40 UTC.

    "Design", "intent/spec.md and rubrics/*.yaml", "validation session under the owner's delegation, independent rubric check (D23) and the CI Claude review; the owner's final acceptance is still to come (who decides: agent and rule, under the owner's delegation)", "https://github.com/ranaidrees/answer-scorer/blob/main/intent/spec.md",
    "Build", "intent/plan.md slice sections, code and tests", "slice sections built as written, with no separate plan pull request (D12); verifier PASS and ci green (who decides: agent and rule)", "https://github.com/ranaidrees/answer-scorer/blob/main/intent/plan.md",
    "Test", "eval reports, label audit and stability proof", "eval gate at the spec's thresholds or stricter; loosening needs the owner (who decides: rule)", "https://github.com/ranaidrees/answer-scorer/blob/main/docs/eval_card.md",
